Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_A: Days a batch takes in the Fermentation Vessel at the best temperature.
Days the Orléans Vinegar Cask takes to fully sour fresh fermented wort at the best temperature, without a mother.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_C: How much faster a cask works with a mother and some sour vinegar left in it.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_T: How much the wrong temperature slows fermentation. Off makes every batch run at full speed.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_M: Days grain takes to sprout on the Malting Floor at the best temperature.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_B: How long the hands-on work takes: kilning the malt, heating the mash, and the steeping, mashing and straining crafts. Light is quickest, Normal takes half as long again, Hard twice as long.
Sandbox_TraditionalPreservationVinegar_W: Wort waiting for the yeast sours: in 2 days at 20 C, 1 at 30 C, about 5 in a cool cellar, never while frozen. The vessel refuses sour wort. Fermented wort keeps.
